Roofing
Web DesignSEOLead Gen

How a Roofing Company Got 412% More Qualified Leads

+412% Qualified Leads 90 Days

The Challenge

A roofing company had a website that looked professional but generated almost zero leads. They relied entirely on expensive lead gen services that ate their margins.

Our Solution

Built a conversion-focused website with location-specific landing pages, instant quote forms, and aggressive local SEO. Added social proof and trust signals throughout.

Results

  • 412% increase in qualified leads in 90 days
  • Reduced cost per lead from $180 to $42
  • Page 1 Google rankings for 12 local keywords
  • Website became the #1 lead source

B2B SaaS Platform 4.9x Return on Ad Spend

4.9x ROAS 6 Months

The Challenge

E-commerce Brand 2.3x Revenue with Faster Site

2.3x Revenue Increase 3 Months

The Challenge

An e-commerce brand had a slow, clunky Shopify site. Load times were 6+ seconds, mobile conversion was terrible, and cart abandonment was at 78%.

Our Solution

Headless rebuild with Astro + Shopify. Sub-second load times, optimized checkout flow, mobile-first design, and abandoned cart recovery integration.

Results

  • 2.3x revenue increase in 90 days
  • Load time reduced from 6.2s to 0.9s
  • Cart abandonment dropped from 78% to 52%
  • Mobile conversion up 184%
